name: System Data
description: Data unique to, and under control of the system.

name: Authentication Data
description: Data used to manage access to the system.

name: Operations Data
description: Data used for system operations.

name: User Data
description: Data related to the user of the system, either provided directly or derived based on their usage.

name: Account Information
description: Account creation or registration information.

name: Authorization Information
description: Scope of permissions and access to a system.

name: Observed Behavior
description: Behavioral data about the subject.

name: Biometric Data
description: Encoded characteristics provided by a user.

name: Children's Data
description: Data relating to children.

name: Contact Data
description: Contact data collected about a user.

name: User Content
description: Content related to, or created by the subject.

name: Demographic Data
description: Demographic data about a user.

name: Location Data
description: Records of the location of a user.

name: Device Data
description: Data related to a user's device, configuration and setting.

name: Payment Data
description: Payment data related to user.

name: Social Data
description: Social activity and interaction data.

name: Unique ID
description: Unique identifier for a user assigned through system use.

name: Telemetry Data
description: User identifiable measurement data from system sensors and monitoring.

name: User Sensor Data
description: Measurement data about a user's environment through system use.

name: Workplace
description: Organization of employment.

name: Sensor Data
description: Measurement data from sensors and monitoring systems.

name: Financial Data
description: Payment data and financial history.

name: Government ID
description: State provided identification data.

name: Health and Medical Data
description: Health records or individual's personal medical information.

name: Name
description: User's real name.

name: Criminal History
description: Criminal records or information about the data subject.

name: Privacy Preferences
description: Privacy preferences or settings set by the subject.

name: Job Title
description: Professional data.

name: Account Settings
description: Account preferences and settings.

name: Account Username
description: Username associated with account.

name: Account password
description: Authentication credentials to a system.

name: Biometric Credentials
description: Credentials for system authentication.

name: Password
description: Password for system authentication.

name: Browsing History
description: Content browsing history of a user.

name: Media Consumption
description: Content consumption history of the subject.

name: Purchase History
description: Purchase history of the subject.

name: Search History
description: Search history of the subject.

name: Fingerprint
description: Fingerprint encoded data about a subject.

name: Retina Scan
description: Retinal data about a subject.

name: Voice Recording
description: Voice encoded data about a subject.

name: Biometric Health Data
description: Encoded characteristic collected about a user.

name: User Contact Address
description: Contact address data collected about a user.

name: User Contact Email
description: User's contact email address.

name: User Contact Phone Number
description: User's phone number.

name: User Website
description: Subject's websites or links to social and personal profiles.

name: Fax Number
description: Data Subject's fax number.

name: Organization
description: Data Subject's Organization.

name: User Contact City
description: User's city level address data.

name: User Contact Country
description: User's country level address data.

name: User Contact Postal Code
description: User's postal code.

name: User Contact State
description: User's state level address data.

name: User Contact Street
description: User's street level address data.

name: Private Content
description: Private content related to, or created by the subject, not publicly available.

name: Public Content
description: Publicly shared Content related to, or created by the subject.

name: User Image
description: Photograph or image in which subject is whole or partially recognized.

name: Age Range
description: Non specific age or age-range of data subject.

name: Birth Date
description: Date of birth of data subject.

name: Gender
description: Gender of data subject.

name: Language
description: Spoken or written language of subject.

name: Marital Status
description: Marital status of data subject.

name: Political Opinion
description: Political opinion or belief of data subject.

name: User Profile Data
description: Profile or preference information about the data subject.

name: Race
description: Race or ethnicity of data subject.

name: Religion
description: Religion or religious beliefs of the data subject.

name: Sexual Orientation
description: Sexual orientation of data subject.

name: Device Cookie
description: Data related to a subject, stored within a cookie.

name: Cookie ID
description: Cookie unique identification number.

name: Device ID
description: Device unique identification number.

name: IP Address
description: Unique identifier related to device connection.

name: Bank Account Information
description: Bank account information belonging to the subject.

name: Credit Card Information
description: Credit card information belonging to the subject.

name: Birth Certificate
description: State issued certificate of birth.

name: Driver's License Number
description: State issued driving identification number.

name: Immigration ID
description: State issued immigration or residency data.

name: National Identification Number
description: State issued personal identification number.

name: Passport Number
description: State issued passport data.

name: Vehicle Registration
description: State issued license plate or vehicle registration data.

name: User's Genetic Data
description: Data about the genetic makeup provided by the subject.

name: Medical Insurance ID
description: Health insurance beneficiary number of the subject.

name: Medical Record ID
description: Medical record identifiers belonging to a subject.

name: Imprecise Subject Location
description: Imprecise location derived from sensors (more than 500M).

name: Precise Subject Location
description: Precise location derived from sensors (less than 500M).

name: First Name
description: Subject's first name.

name: Last Name
description: Subject's last, or family, name.

name: Pseudonymous User ID
description: A pseudonymous, or probabilistic identifier generated from other subject or device data belonging to the subject.

name: Analytics
description: Provides analytics for activities such as system and advertising performance reporting, insights and fraud detection.

name: Analytics for Reporting
description: Provides analytics for general reporting such as system and advertising performance.

name: Analytics for Advertising Performance
description: Provides analytics for reporting of advertising performance.

name: Analytics for Content Performance
description: Analytics for reporting on content performance.

name: Analytics for Insights
description: Provides analytics for reporting of campaign insights related to advertising and promotion activities.

name: Analytics for System Activity
description: Provides analytics for reporting on system activity.

name: Analytics for System Performance
description: Provides analytics for reporting on system performance.

name: Collect
description: Collects or stores data in order to use it for another purpose which has not yet been expressly defined.

name: Employment
description: Processes data for the purpose of recruitment or employment and human resources (HR) related activities.

name: Employment Recruitment
description: Processes data of prospective employees for the purpose of recruitment.

name: Essential
description: Operates the service or product, including legal obligations, support and basic system operations.

name: Essential Fraud Detection
description: Detects possible fraud or misuse of the product, service, application or system.

name: Essential Legal Obligation
description: Provides service to meet a legal or compliance obligation such as consent management.

name: Essential for Service
description: Provides the essential product, service, application or system, without which the product/service would not be possible.

name: Essential Service Authentication
description: Authenticate users to the product, service, application or system.

name: Essential Service Notifications
description: Sends notifications about the product, service, application or system.

name: Essential for Operations
description: Essential to ensure the operation of the product, service, application or system.

name: Essential for Payment Processing
description: Essential to processes payments for the product, service, application or system.

name: Essential for Security
description: Essential to provide security for the product, service, application or system

name: Essential for Service Upgrades
description: Provides timely system upgrade information options.

name: Essential Email Service Notifications
description: Sends email notifications about the product, service, application or system.

name: Essential SMS Service Notifications
description: Sends SMS notifications about the product, service, application or system.

name: Essential for Operations Support
description: Provides support for the product, service, application or system.

name: Essential for Support Improvement
description: Essential to optimize and improve support for the product, service, application or system.

name: Finance
description: Enables finance and accounting activities such as audits and tax reporting.

name: Functional
description: Used for specific, necessary, and legitimate purposes

name: Local Data Storage
description: Stores or accesses information from the device as needed when using a product, service, application, or system

name: Service
description: Functions relating to provided services, products, applications or systems.

name: Improve Service
description: Improves the specific product, service, application or system.

name: Local Data Storage for Privacy Preferences
description: Stores or accesses privacy preferences information from the device as needed when using a product, service, application, or system

name: Marketing
description: Enables marketing, promotion, advertising and sales activities for the product, service, application or system.

name: Advertising, Marketing or Promotion
description: Advertises or promotes the product, service, application or system and associated services.

name: Marketing Communications
description: Uses combined channels to message and market to a customer, user or prospect.

name: First Party Advertising
description: Serves advertisements based on first party data collected or derived about the user.

name: Frequency Capping
description: Restricts the number of times a specific advertisement is shown to an individual.

name: Negative Targeting
description: Enforces rules used to ensure a certain audience or group is not targeted by advertising.

name: Profiling for Advertising
description: Creates audience profiles for the purpose of targeted advertising

name: Essential for Serving Ads
description: Essential to the delivery of advertising and content.

name: Third Party Advertising
description: Serves advertisements based on data within the system or joined with data provided by 3rd parties.

name: First Party Contextual Advertising
description: Serves advertisements based on current content being viewed by the user of the system or service.

name: First Party Personalized Advertising
description: Targets advertisements based on data collected or derived about the user from use of the system.

name: Third Party Targeted Advertising
description: Targets advertisements based on data within the system or joined with data provided by 3rd parties.

name: Marketing Email Communications
description: Sends email marketing communications.

name: Marketing SMS Communications
description: Sends SMS marketing communications.

name: Operations
description: Supports business processes necessary to the organization's operation.

name: Personalize
description: Personalizes the product, service, application or system.

name: Content Personalization
description: Personalizes the content of the product, service, application or system.

name: System Personalization
description: Personalizes the system.

name: Limited Content Personalization
description: Uses limited data for the purpose of serving content.

name: Profiling for Personalization
description: Creates profiles for the purpose of serving content.

name: Targeted Content Personalization
description: Uses profiles for the purpose of serving content.

name: Sales
description: Supports sales activities such as communications and outreach.

name: Third Party Sharing
description: Transfers data to third parties outside of the system or service's scope.

name: Sharing for Legal Obligation
description: Shares data for legal obligations, including contracts, applicable laws or regulations.

name: Train AI System
description: Trains an AI system or data model for machine learning.

name: Anonymous User
description: An individual that is unidentifiable to the systems. Note - This should only be applied to truly anonymous users where there is no risk of re-identification

name: Citizen Voter
description: An individual registered to voter with a state or authority.

name: Commuter
description: An individual that is traveling or transiting in the context of location tracking.

name: Consultant
description: An individual employed in a consultative/temporary capacity by the organization.

name: Customer
description: An individual or other organization that purchases goods or services from the organization.

name: Employee
description: An individual employed by the organization.

name: Job Applicant
description: An individual applying for employment to the organization.

name: Next of Kin
description: A relative of any other individual subject where such a relationship is known.

name: Passenger
description: An individual traveling on some means of provided transport.

name: Patient
description: An individual identified for the purposes of any medical care.

name: Prospect
description: An individual or organization to whom an organization is selling goods or services.

name: Shareholder
description: An individual or organization that holds equity in the organization.

name: Supplier/Vendor
description: An individual or organization that provides services or goods to the organization.

name: Trainee
description: An individual undergoing training by the organization.

name: Visitor
description: An individual visiting a location.
